# Gradle wrapper provenance

Pinned Gradle: **8.11.1**. The wrapper scripts and JAR were generated by the
checksum-verified official Gradle 8.11.1 binary distribution using its `wrapper`
task. No third-party wrapper binary was used.

## Official sources

- Distribution: <https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.11.1-bin.zip>
- Distribution SHA-256: <https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.11.1-bin.zip.sha256>
- Gradle distribution and wrapper checksum reference: <https://gradle.org/release-checksums/>

Verified 2026-10-28:

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `gradle-8.11.1-bin.zip` | `f397b287023acdba1e9f6fc5ea72d22dd63669d59ed4a289a29b1a76eee151c6` |
| `gradle-wrapper.jar` | `2db75c40782f5e8ba1fc278a5574bab070adccb2d21ca5a6e5ed840888448046` |
| `gradlew` | `a3648413b47ef77af21d5ebc36c687c7d103aaef3e17f33de7d4f080a6f300a3` |
| `gradlew.bat` | `57931b17dd228e5c24dac90e815d0bf82477e831a4618dfab4136f5446b42a9f` |

The official reference publishes the first two checksums; the script checksums
record the locally generated files. `distributionSha256Sum` is pinned in
`gradle-wrapper.properties`, and distribution URL validation is enabled.

## Reproduce

After independently verifying the distribution checksum, run its Gradle binary:

```sh
gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.11.1 --distribution-type bin \
  --gradle-distribution-sha256-sum f397b287023acdba1e9f6fc5ea72d22dd63669d59ed4a289a29b1a76eee151c6
printf '%s  %s\n' \
  2db75c40782f5e8ba1fc278a5574bab070adccb2d21ca5a6e5ed840888448046 \
  gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar | sha256sum -c -
```

On restricted execution environments, point `GRADLE_USER_HOME` at a writable
cache directory. If the environment supplies an HTTP(S) proxy, Java/Gradle may
need matching `-Dhttp.proxyHost` / `-Dhttp.proxyPort` and HTTPS equivalents in
`GRADLE_OPTS`. Derive these from the current invocation environment: managed
proxies can rotate ports between command sessions. Do not commit
environment-specific proxy details, credentials, or SDK paths.

`python3 tools/gradle-env.py <Gradle arguments>` is an optional disposable-cloud
helper for this environment handling. Normal developer builds use `./gradlew`.
The helper respects an existing `GRADLE_USER_HOME`, otherwise uses
`/tmp/yeouro-gradle-home`, rejects credentialed proxy URLs, and does not persist
proxy settings.

Generating/verifying this wrapper does not install an Android SDK, accept SDK
licenses, compile an APK, or establish vehicle/Pleos platform compatibility.
